title: Spanish Daily Challenges
delivery: one challenge per day; 5–10 minutes; no new grammar required

challenge_rules.streak_policy: award consistency points but never lock educational content behind a streak

challenges.title: Identity Ping
challenges.prompt: Say your name and ask another person’s name three times, changing the names. Use 'du' with friends; 'Sie' is the formal form.
challenges.target_pattern: Ich heiße ____. Wie heißt du?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Vowel Radar
challenges.prompt: Record yourself saying a, e, i, o, u, then one word for each vowel.
challenges.target_pattern: a e i o u; Apfel, Bett, Insel, Oma, Uhr
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Origin Exchange
challenges.prompt: Answer where you are from and ask the question back.
challenges.target_pattern: Ich komme aus ____. Woher kommst du?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Article Hunt
challenges.prompt: Find or imagine five objects and label each with der, die, das, or die (plural).
challenges.target_pattern: der Tisch; die Lampe; das Buch; die Häuser
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Human Snapshot
challenges.prompt: Describe one person with a noun and two agreeing adjectives.
challenges.target_pattern: Das ist mein Freund/meine Freundin. Er/Sie ist ____ und ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Question Chain
challenges.prompt: Ask qué, quién, dónde, and cómo questions about one scene (use the German equivalents).
challenges.target_pattern: Was ist das? Wer ist das? Wo ist es? Wie geht es ihm/ihr?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: First Contact
challenges.prompt: Complete a 45-second introduction without reading.
challenges.target_pattern: Hallo. Ich heiße ____. Ich komme aus ____. Freut mich.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Room Scan
challenges.prompt: Describe three objects using 'es gibt', 'ist', or 'sind'.
challenges.target_pattern: Es gibt ____. Der/Die ____ ist ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Verb Sprint
challenges.prompt: Conjugate sprechen, lernen, and arbeiten for ich, du, and er/sie aloud.
challenges.target_pattern: spreche/sprichst/spricht; lerne/lernst/lernt; arbeite/arbeitest/arbeitet
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: People Map
challenges.prompt: Describe three people using mein, dein, sein, or unser.
challenges.target_pattern: Mein ____. Dein ____. Unser ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Yes/No Flip
challenges.prompt: Turn three positive sentences into questions and answer each positively and negatively.
challenges.target_pattern: Sprichst du? Ja, ich spreche. Nein, ich spreche nicht.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Preposition Walk
challenges.prompt: Describe where you are, where you go, and with whom.
challenges.target_pattern: Ich bin in ____. Ich gehe nach ____. Ich gehe mit ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Routine Relay
challenges.prompt: Give a four-step routine using primero, después, luego, finalmente (use the German equivalents).
challenges.target_pattern: Zuerst ____. Danach ____. Später ____. Zum Schluss ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Daily Briefing
challenges.prompt: Give a 60-second report about home, routine, and one negative fact.
challenges.target_pattern: Ich wohne in ____. Zuerst ____. Ich mache nicht ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Café Recall
challenges.prompt: Order two items and reject one item politely.
challenges.target_pattern: Ich möchte ____, bitte. Ich möchte ____ nicht.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Help Signal
challenges.prompt: Ask for help, then respond that you can or cannot help.
challenges.target_pattern: Kannst du mir helfen? Ja, ich kann. / Ich kann noch nicht.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Number Ladder
challenges.prompt: Count 1–30, then schedule two actions at different times.
challenges.target_pattern: Ich lerne um ____. Ich arbeite um ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Market Mission
challenges.prompt: Point to two items, ask the price of one, and thank the seller.
challenges.target_pattern: Ich möchte dieses/diese ____. Wie viel kostet das? Danke.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Preference Pulse
challenges.prompt: Say one singular preference, one plural preference, and one dislike.
challenges.target_pattern: Mir gefällt ____. Mir gefallen ____. Ich mag ____ nicht.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Needs and Wants
challenges.prompt: Combine quiero, necesito, and me gusta in one mini-dialogue (use German equivalents).
challenges.target_pattern: Ich möchte ____. Ich brauche ____. Mir gefällt ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Tomorrow Board
challenges.prompt: State three plans for tomorrow and ask someone else’s plan.
challenges.target_pattern: Morgen werde ich ____. Was wirst du machen?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Map Route
challenges.prompt: Give a two-step route to a familiar place.
challenges.target_pattern: Geh geradeaus und biege nach ____ ab. Es ist in der Nähe.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Glue Words
challenges.prompt: Join four pairs of sentences using y, pero, porque, or también (use the German equivalents y=und, pero=aber, porque=weil, también=auch).
challenges.target_pattern: Ich mag ____ weil ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Irregular Five
challenges.prompt: Use soy, estoy, tengo, voy, and hago in five different sentences (use German equivalents).
challenges.target_pattern: Ich bin ____. Ich bin ____. Ich habe ____. Ich gehe ____. Ich mache ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Turn-Taking
challenges.prompt: Answer a question, ask ¿Y tú? (And you?), and ask one follow-up.
challenges.target_pattern: Antwort. Und du? Was machst du gern?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Three-Pass Listening
challenges.prompt: Listen to a short German clip three times: situation, facts, useful phrase.
challenges.target_pattern: Situation: ____. Facts: ____. Phrase: ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Paraphrase Rescue
challenges.prompt: Explain one unknown object using 'thing', 'for', and a known verb (use German equivalents).
challenges.target_pattern: Das ist etwas zum ____.
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.

challenges.title: Final Voice Note
challenges.prompt: Record a 2–3 minute everyday German voice note using identity, routine, preference, plan, and repair.
challenges.target_pattern: Hallo. Ich heiße ____. Ich komme aus ____. Mir gefällt ____. Morgen werde ich ____. Kannst du das wiederholen?
challenges.completion_check: Learner submits a response or passes the structured evaluator; hints are shown only after first attempt.
